name: @zedec/zxv
description: TypeScript SDK for the ZXV platform core (libzxv): exact rationals, four-valued logic, capabilities, budgets, phase ticks, UBH-168 frames, swarm economy, post-quantum crypto and a deterministic integer inference engine. Node-API addon for servers, WebAssembly for browsers.

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
